question: Analyze the soccer match dataset to determine the champion team for each season across all countries and leagues, awarding 3 points for every win, 1 point for every tie, and 0 points for every loss. For each season, return the champion’s team name, the league, the country, and the total points accumulated.
sql:
WITH match_points AS (
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        l.name AS league,
        c.name AS country,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS home_team_points,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS away_team_points,
        t_home.team_long_name AS home_team_name,
        t_away.team_long_name AS away_team_name
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
    JOIN Team t_home ON m.home_team_api_id = t_home.team_api_id
    JOIN Team t_away ON m.away_team_api_id = t_away.team_api_id
),
team_season_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        league,
        country,
        team_name,
        SUM(team_points) AS total_points
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            season, league, country, home_team_name AS team_name, home_team_points AS team_points
            FROM match_points
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 
            season, league, country, away_team_name AS team_name, away_team_points AS team_points
            FROM match_points
    ) combined
    GROUP BY season, league, country, team_name
),
champions AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        league,
        country,
        team_name AS champion_team,
        total_points
    FROM team_season_stats
    WHERE (season, league, total_points) IN (
        SELECT season, league, MAX(total_points)
        FROM team_season_stats
        GROUP BY season, league
    )
)
SELECT champion_team, league, country, total_points
FROM champions
ORDER BY season, league
